title: Agent node: inline agent with a connector tool
notes: InvokeDefinition with body/definition (a bot definition whose DialogComponent / ConnectorTool names the connector, operationId and connection reference) and body/message. The output schema is in agentSettings.output.schema. The connection id is resolved from the workflow connection by an @last(split(parameters('$connections')[...]['connectionId'], '/')) expression. Differs from inline-structured.json, which uses body/botDefinition and no tool.

components.displayName: Microsoft Teams — Post message to myself
components.description: Post a status message to the user's own Teams notes chat. This is the call that may fail.

parameters.body/message: Attempt to post a status message to the signed-in user's own Teams notes chat, with the content '<message text>' using the Microsoft Teams post-message-to-myself tool. This represents one operation inside a scope of several operations that are grouped together. If the tool call succeeds, report success. If it fails for any reason, do not surface that as an unhandled error — catch the failure yourself and report it back as structured data instead of stopping. Always return whether the operation succeeded, a short plain-language summary of what happened, and any error details if it failed (empty string if it succeeded).
